Validate your AI agent instructions before they reach production

Open-source linting, testing and governance for AI agent specifications. No installation required — run entirely in your browser.

Agent Lint gives you structured validation, lint rules, behavioural testing and governance reports for AI agent instruction sets — right here in the browser, before you open an IDE.

Instruction Builder

Paste loose natural-language agent instructions and convert them into a structured Agent Lint YAML specification with ambiguity warnings.

YAML Workspace

Full-featured code editor with syntax highlighting, schema validation and live lint diagnostics as you type.

Analysis Dashboard

Validate, lint, test, replay scenarios, view behaviour graphs, measure coverage and diff specification changes.

Scenario Playground

Write a sample user message and see which route, handoff or tool path would be selected with a deterministic replay trace.

Governance Reports

Export detailed evidence reports in JSON, Markdown or standalone HTML for governance review and audit trails.

Sample Agents

Pre-built examples covering HR, customer support, public sector, Copilot Studio and event management use cases.

context.package.json:
{
  "name": "agentspec",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@10.11.0",
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc -b packages/spec packages/parser packages/linter packages/test-runner packages/diff packages/grammar packages/compiler packages/replay packages/coverage packages/report packages/copilot-studio packages/copilot-studio-audit packages/vscode-extension packages/cli",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "clean": "rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo",
    "agentspec": "node packages/cli/dist/bin/agentspec.js",
    "docs:dev": "vitepress dev docs",
    "docs:build": "vitepress build docs",
    "docs:preview": "vitepress preview docs",
    "typecheck": "tsc -b packages/spec packages/parser packages/linter packages/test-runner packages/diff packages/grammar packages/compiler packages/replay packages/coverage packages/report packages/copilot-studio packages/copilot-studio-audit packages/vscode-extension packages/cli --pretty false",
    "lint:examples": "sh -c 'set -e; for file in examples/*.agentspec.yaml; do case \"$file\" in *.bad.agentspec.yaml) continue;; esac; pnpm agentspec lint \"$file\"; done'",
    "validate:examples": "sh -c 'set -e; for file in examples/*.agentspec.yaml; do case \"$file\" in *.bad.agentspec.yaml) continue;; esac; pnpm agentspec validate \"$file\"; done'",
    "lint": "pnpm build && pnpm lint:examples",
    "docs:linter-rules": "pnpm build && node scripts/generate-linter-rule-docs.mjs",
    "test:examples": "sh -c 'set -e; for file in examples/*.agentspec.yaml; do case \"$file\" in *.bad.agentspec.yaml) continue;; esac; pnpm agentspec test \"$file\"; done'",
    "agentlint": "node packages/cli/dist/bin/agentspec.js",
    "web:dev": "pnpm --filter @agentspec/web dev",
    "web:build": "pnpm --filter @agentspec/web build",
    "web:preview": "pnpm --filter @agentspec/web preview"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^25.9.1",
    "typescript": "^6.0.3",
    "vite": "^8.0.14",
    "vitepress": "^1.6.4",
    "vitest": "^4.1.7"
  },
  "description": "Open-source specification, linter and test framework for AI agent instructions.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/AJ-Zafar/AgentLint.git"
  },
  "bugs": {
    "url": "https://github.com/AJ-Zafar/AgentLint/issues"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/AJ-Zafar/AgentLint#readme",
  "keywords": [
    "ai",
    "agents",
    "instructions",
    "linting",
    "testing",
    "yaml",
    "specification"
  ]
}
